name: Phoenix and Sedona, Arizona
mood: the Arizona desert at a glowing sunrise, red rocks blazing orange, soft purple shadows, saguaros, clear and warm
opening: Sedona's red rock buttes glowing orange at sunrise, giant saguaro cacti and desert wildflowers in the foreground, a small adobe chapel in the rocks
sky: a clear desert sunrise sky, warm apricot near the bottom fading to soft blue above, a few pink-lit clouds.
skyline: the red rock buttes and mesas of Sedona including Cathedral Rock and Bell Rock, glowing in sunrise light.
ground_band: Sonoran desert with tall saguaro cacti, palo verde trees, ocotillo and red earth.
near: desert sand with barrel cacti, prickly pear, brittlebush flowers and red stones
landmarks: the Chapel of the Holy Cross in the rocks
local: an adobe house with a flat roof

name: London, England
mood: London on a cozy rainy winter evening, soft blue dusk, warm golden lamps and windows, glistening wet streets, red buses, festive lights
opening: the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben clock tower lit gold at dusk across the Thames, a red double-decker bus on Westminster Bridge, rain shimmering
sky: a rainy winter dusk sky, soft deep blue with low clouds and a warm glow near the bottom.
skyline: the London skyline along the Thames with St Paul's dome, the Shard and Tower Bridge, lit at dusk.
ground_band: a continuous terrace of Georgian townhouses with lit windows, black railings, a red phone box and a pub with warm light.
near: a wet black iron railing with holly, ivy and puddles reflecting lamps
local: a Georgian townhouse with lit windows
a cozy pub with hanging baskets
a plane tree with fairy lights

name: Minneapolis, Minnesota
mood: Minneapolis on a bright snowy winter morning, sparkling fresh snow, clear blue sky, frozen lakes, cozy cabins, crisp and cheerful
opening: the stone arch bridge over the frozen Mississippi with the snowy Minneapolis skyline behind, skaters on a frozen lake in the foreground
sky: a bright winter morning sky, clear cold blue with a few soft white clouds.
skyline: the Minneapolis skyline beside the frozen Mississippi River in sparkling snow.
ground_band: a frozen lake with skaters, ice-fishing huts and snowy birch and pine shores.
near: deep fresh snow with snowy pine branches and a wooden fence
landmarks: the old flour mill with its sign shape (no readable text)
local: a craftsman house with a snowy porch

name: Prague, Czech Republic
mood: Prague on a snowy Christmas-market evening, deep blue dusk, warm golden lights, snow on red roofs and spires, magical and cozy
opening: Prague Castle and St Vitus Cathedral lit gold on the hill above snowy red roofs, the Charles Bridge with statues over the Vltava river
sky: a snowy evening sky, deep blue fading to a warm glow near the bottom, light snow falling.
skyline: the Prague skyline of a hundred spires with the castle on the hill, lit at dusk in snow.
ground_band: a continuous row of pastel baroque houses with snowy red roofs and lit windows, and a Christmas market with wooden stalls.
near: a snowy stone parapet with evergreen garlands and small lights
landmarks: the Church of Our Lady before Tyn with twin spires
local: a pastel baroque house with a snowy roof
a mulled wine stall with steam
a snowy fir tree with lights

name: Charleston, South Carolina
mood: Charleston on a warm spring afternoon, soft sunshine, pastel houses, palmettos, harbour breeze, gentle and elegant
opening: Rainbow Row's pastel houses along the waterfront with palmetto trees, a church steeple, the harbour and sailboats beyond
sky: a warm spring afternoon sky, soft blue with gentle white clouds and a warm glow near the bottom.
skyline: the Charleston harbour with the cable-stayed bridge and distant church steeples.
ground_band: a continuous row of pastel Rainbow Row houses with shutters, piazzas and palmettos along a cobbled street.
near: a wrought-iron fence with jasmine, palmetto fronds and pink azaleas
landmarks: an antebellum single house with piazzas

name: Bangkok, Thailand
mood: Bangkok at a warm monsoon dusk after a light shower, glowing temples, golden spires, river boats with lights, humid and cozy
opening: Wat Arun temple's tall spire glowing at dusk across the Chao Phraya river, longtail boats and lit river ferries, temple roofs with golden finials
sky: a warm monsoon dusk sky, rose and amber near the bottom fading to soft violet above, soft rain clouds.
skyline: the Bangkok skyline across the river with golden temple spires and modern towers, lit at dusk.
ground_band: a continuous riverbank of wooden stilt houses, temple roofs with orange and green tiles, palms and moored longtail boats.
near: lotus leaves, frangipani flowers and banana leaves wet with rain
landmarks: the Grand Palace roofs with golden spires
local: a street food stall with lanterns
a spirit house on a post
a floating market boat with fruit

name: Salt Lake City, Utah
mood: Utah on a clear summer morning, crisp blue sky, sunlit Wasatch peaks, white salt flats, sage-green valleys, bright and open
opening: the Salt Lake temple spires and the domed state capitol below the green Wasatch mountains, with the great salt lake shimmering in the distance
sky: a clear summer morning sky, deep blue above fading to pale blue near the bottom, no clouds.
skyline: the Wasatch mountain range above the valley with a few snow patches on the highest peaks.
ground_band: the white salt flats and shimmering salt lake with distant islands.
near: sagebrush, wild sunflowers and a weathered ranch fence
landmarks: a white temple with six spires
a golden spike railroad monument with two steam engines

name: Cape Town, South Africa
mood: Cape Town on a bright summer day, deep blue sky, flat-topped Table Mountain with a cloud tablecloth, turquoise sea, colourful houses, fresh and vivid
opening: Table Mountain with a cloud tablecloth above the city and the V&A waterfront harbour, colourful Bo-Kaap houses in the foreground
sky: a bright summer sky, deep blue with a few white clouds near the bottom.
skyline: flat-topped Table Mountain, Lion's Head and Devil's Peak above the city by the sea.
ground_band: a continuous row of brightly painted Bo-Kaap houses in pink, lime, blue and yellow on a cobbled street.
near: fynbos shrubs, orange strelitzia flowers and protea blooms
landmarks: Table Mountain with its cable car
a lighthouse with red and white stripes

opening: the Pittsburgh skyline at the point where three rivers meet, yellow steel bridges, the fountain at the point, autumn hills and an incline railway
sky: a golden autumn afternoon sky, soft blue with warm gold near the bottom and a few clouds.
skyline: the Pittsburgh skyline with glass towers at the meeting of three rivers, and wooded hills.
ground_band: steep autumn hillsides with stacked houses and staircases, orange and red trees.
near: autumn leaves, a stone retaining wall and a yellow-painted steel railing
landmarks: the gothic Cathedral of Learning tower
local: a brick row house on a hill
a red oak tree in autumn

name: Vancouver, Canada

opening: the Vancouver skyline of glass towers across the harbour with misty snow-capped North Shore mountains, a seaplane landing, totem poles in Stanley Park
sky: a soft rainy spring sky, layered silver-grey clouds with a pale glow near the bottom.
skyline: the North Shore mountains with snow caps above the harbour and the glass-tower skyline, in mist.
ground_band: the Stanley Park seawall with tall cedars, totem poles and the harbour.
near: wet ferns, salal and pink cherry blossom branches
local: a glass tower with green balconies
a bald eagle on a post
